items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: And Leonardo DaVinci, because I like art too, I paint and draw. And somebody gave me the Leonardo DaVinci notebooks.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well Jo Jones, here’s the funniest thing I ever heard in my life, when I first met him and I never heard nobody say that before, he said “you’ve got to unlearn yourself.” I’d never heard that before. It took me a long time to figure out but I understand it now. You’ve got to unlearn yourself. And Leonardo DaVinci, because I like art too, I paint and draw. And somebody gave me the Leonardo DaVinci notebooks. And somewhere in there he said “never let theory outstrip the performance.”
